definition: a limousine with a glass screen inside
description: Inside a long black luxury car on a rainy night in a city, a young female chauffeur in a black peaked cap, black jacket and leather gloves drives calmly, looking ahead. Behind her a clear glass wall divides the car, and in the back seat a laughing bride in a lace wedding dress and a young woman in a pink dress hit each other with pillows, filling the back with flying white feathers. City lights blur through the wet windows.
